headers: Pour — Rust Idiomaticity & Pragmatic Refactor Audit
How to use this document (note for Mentor)
Group A — Error handling (Ch.9) and ? propagation
A.1 — expect("...verified above") panics in supposedly-unreachable branches
A.2 — Best-effort I/O via let _ = ... — make the error type explicit
A.4 — anyhow::bail! vs typed errors — the transport/fs.rs boundary
Group B — Ownership, borrowing, and .clone() audit (Ch.4, Ch.10, Ch.15)
B.2 — String parameters that should be &str (or impl AsRef<str>)
B.4 — Cow<'_, str> would clarify the "borrow if possible, own if needed" pattern
Group C — Iterators, closures, and pattern matching (Ch.13, Ch.18)
C.1 — for loops that should be iterator chains — Cache::set and friends
C.2 — Match-on-(Option, Option) could be cleaner
Group D — Type system: enums, newtypes, generics (Ch.6, Ch.10, Ch.17)
D.1 — Option<Option<T>> as a tri-state — newtype opportunity
D.2 — Stringly-typed config setting kinds — already an enum (positive)
D.3 — Boolean parameters that should be enums
Group E — Modules, visibility, and API surface (Ch.7)
E.2 — pub use re-exports as the public-facing API
F.2 — FieldType is an enum, not a trait — explicitly chosen, deviation-marked
F.3 — Default impls — both derived and hand-rolled
Group G — Smart pointers and shared state (Ch.15, Ch.16)
G.2 — No Rc<T> in the codebase — single-threaded fields use & borrowing
H.2 — select! is conspicuously absent — and that's correct
H.3 — transport::Transport::connect is async even though both branches are mostly synchronous
I.1 — Tests in tests/<module>.rs mirror layout — already enforced
I.2 — tempfile::tempdir() for hermetic filesystem tests — already idiomatic
I.4 — #[should_panic] is absent — tests use Result::is_err instead
Group K — Naming and API ergonomics
K.2 — Builder pattern absent — and rightly so
